about: Nothing gets worse (tools/no-regression.py, docs/MAINTENANCE.md): I.K.E.'s known external endpoints, the hosts it may contact by itself. A host a candidate contacts and main does not passes with no person only when it is declared here and the candidate's own code (outside tests/) names it; otherwise it is worse. Only a person (or Claude, with the change read in full) edits this file: it is under tests/, so the automatic fix may not touch it and a pull request that changes it never merges by itself. Each entry: the exact host ("host"), what I.K.E. uses it for ("purpose"), where the code names it ("where"), and who declared it when ("declared").

endpoints.purpose: the EasyList and EasyPrivacy filter lists
Chrome's current stable version, for the user agent
the default search engine and its suggestions
